title: Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.11821v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Alignment of text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions is a key challenge in controllable generation. Existing approaches typically rely on optimizing model inputs or fine-tuning denoising networks, which requires computationally expensive backpropagation through large denoising models. In this work, we propose Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that performs alignment by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory of diffusion models. Specifically, DTO treats intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as the optimization variables, eliminating the need for gradients through the denoising network. To mitigate the out-of-distribution problem, we introduce Reward-Optimized Score Guidance, which interpolates between the optimized scores and the pretrained model predictions to stabilize sampling, while providing a provable theoretical guarantee of reward improvement under constrained dis

translated_title: 面向文本到图像扩散模型推理时对齐的直接轨迹优化
translated_abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型与奖励函数的对齐是可控生成中的一项关键挑战。现有方法通常依赖于优化模型输入或微调去噪网络，这需要通过大型去噪模型进行计算代价高昂的反向传播。在本工作中，我们提出了直接轨迹优化（Direct Trajectory Optimization, DTO），这是一个无需训练的框架，通过直接优化扩散模型的采样轨迹来实现对齐。具体而言，DTO 将中间去噪分数和采样噪声作为优化变量，从而免除了通过去噪网络计算梯度的需要。为了缓解分布外问题，我们引入了奖励优化分数引导，它在优化后的分数与预训练模型预测之间进行插值以稳定采样，同时在受约束的分布条件下提供了可证明的奖励提升理论保证。
tldr: 提出无需训练的 DTO 框架，通过将中间去噪分数和采样噪声作为优化变量直接优化扩散模型的采样轨迹，实现文本到图像模型的推理时奖励对齐，避免了通过去噪网络的高成本反向传播，并提供奖励提升的理论保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that aligns text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions at inference time by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory—treating intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as optimization variables—thereby eliminating costly backpropagation through the denoising network while providing theoretical guarantees of reward improvement.
